Based on general AI engineering knowledge, a developer can track several critical metrics to ensure an automated agent is performing reliably:
Trajectory & Reasoning: Logging the agent's "thought process" (Chain-of-Thought) to see how it planned and execu
text.tspan: Based on general AI engineering knowledge, a developer can track several critical metrics to
ensure an automated agent is performing reliably:
Trajectory & Reasoning: Logging the agent's "thought process" (Chain-of-Thought) to see how it
Tool Call Accuracy: Tracking which tools were called, the arguments passed, and whether the
tool returned a successful response or an error.
Monitoring the cost (tokens) and speed (time to first token/total response time) per task.
Loop Detection: Identifying if an agent is stuck in an infinite loop of repeating the same
Success Rate (Rubrics): Measuring the final output against a predefined rubric or ground truth to
determine if the goal was actually achieved.
Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Intervention: Tracking how often a human had to correct the agent
or provide approval.Tracking how often a human had to correct the agent or provide approval.
